mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(uncollected_amount), 0) FROM ar_invoice WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 30 THEN '0-30天' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60天' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90天' ELSE '90天以上' END AS bucket, COALESCE(SUM(uncollected_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ar_invoice WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 AND uncollected_amount > 0 GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
